integrity: Two standalone exact finite verifiers were executed; one determines the Cayley action, one independently enumerates edge-flip pairs in an isomorphic graph model. No independent scholarly audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the ten-vertex Petersen graph; no claim for larger cubic graphs or arbitrary Hamiltonian-path reconfiguration spaces. Earlier unindexed equivalences remain a possibility.
title: The Petersen Hamiltonian-path backbite graph is a diameter-six Cayley graph of \(S_5\)
